International Cheese Federation Member Spotlight
This page from the International Cheese Federation features recent 'Member Spotlight' articles, highlighting various professionals within the cheese industry. The spotlights showcase members discussing their experiences and expertise, including preferences for raw-milk cheese, challenges in cheesemaking supply for small creameries, the art of affinage, and practical applications of environmental monitoring for craft facilities.

Member Spotlight 

 

 

 



Yuri Lee 




 


Twenty years in, still choosing raw-milk cheese 

 

Kate O’Leary has run cheese programs for two decades. We talked to her about why raw-milk cheese still gets most of her attention, and what she looks for in a producer.

Yuri Lee 




 


Thirteen years in the territory: a member spotlight 

 

Bob Kowalski has spent thirteen years selling cheesemaking supply into small creameries. We asked him what’s actually changed on his territory since he started.

Member Spotlight 

 

 

 



Yuri Lee 




 


New member spotlight: a Jura affineur joins us 

 

Henri Dubois of Fromagerie Saint-Rémille joined the federation last month. He runs a maturation room in the Jura, he flips wheels by hand, and he has opinions about airflow.

Member Spotlight 

 

 

 



Yuri Lee 




 


Building the swab map at Quincewick Creamery 

 

Quality manager Aisha Bell walked us through her environmental monitoring program at Quincewick Creamery, sharing practical lessons on winter zone mapping, drain swabs, and sanitation hurdles for craft facilities.
